name: Long Lost Daughter
source:
Your first teaching opportunity mysteriously opens up in an all-girl academy in the town you grew up in. You move your loving wife and peculiar twin daughters hundreds of miles to the middle of the country and are soon joined by your mother in your new home. As soon as you enter the school, your life takes turns you never could have imagined and you literally come face-to-face with your sordid past.

This VN takes place in the comic strip [url=https://www.sinfest.net/]Sinfest[/url] universe.
translation:
你的第一个教学机会神秘地出现在你长大的小镇的一所女子学院里。你把你亲爱的妻子和奇怪的双胞胎女儿搬到数百英里外的国家中部，很快你的母亲就搬到了你的新家。当你进入学校的那一刻，你的生活发生了你从未想象过的转变，你真正面对了你肮脏的过去。

这个VN发生在漫画 [url=https://www.sinfest.net/]Sinfest[/url] 宇宙中。
